acceptance: routes.yml declares Astro sources per route with pinned refs; assembly tests updated
All dlv2-60 pre-deploy gates run on an Astro-built candidate and pass
Preview deploy of an Astro candidate with probes, receipt and a rollback-by-receipt drill to the last Sphinx artifact
Mixed state (Sphinx /docs/ from tag + Astro /docs/dev/ and /blog/ from trunk) renders a consistent header and passes link checks
context: The mixed-version window is real: release-pinned /docs/ stays on Sphinx until a release ships website/. The shared header must therefore work on both. Keep landing/shared assets until the last Sphinx-built route is gone.
description:
After dlv2-62, site-deploy is the only production writer. Extend its route manifest (site/routes.yml) and assembly so each route is built from its pinned source:
- / and /docs/: Astro built from the latest release tag. This requires a release tag that contains website/; until one exists, those routes keep the Sphinx build from the tag.
- /docs/dev/ and /blog/: Astro built from trunk.
- /results/: the Explorer artifact plus the corpus snapshot, each pinned by its own SHA and digest.
- API reference: release-pinned.

Keep artifact assembly and verification: per-route source SHA, corpus SHA, artifact sha256, privacy gate, explorer-compat (both orders), corpus bijection, digest, cross-route link check, post-deploy probes, receipts, and rollback-by-receipt.

The assemble step may be rewritten to consume Astro output, but no gate is removed.
